{{Youmay|the [[in-universe]] essay|the [[Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena (article)|Star Wars Hyperspace article]]}}
'''''Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena''''' was an essay by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tam Azur-Jamin]] on the emergence of technology and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], focusing in particular on a group of [[Shard (species)|Shard]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known as the [[Iron Knight]]s.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The article was written by [[Abel G. Peña]] for [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section published [[March]] [[2005]]. It is written from the [[in-universe]] perspective of a Jedi Knight, and Peña is listed as "translator" rather than author.
